## Description
Briefly summarize the changes introduced in this pull request and the rationale behind them.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 🎨 UI / UX Overhaul or Visual Polish
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] 🛠️ Refactoring / Code quality
- [ ] 📝 Documentation update
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number) / Closes #(issue number)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` and confirmed zero TypeScript errors
- [ ] I have run `npm run test` and all automated tests pass
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` and confirmed successful build output
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] I have updated documentation / CHANGELOG as appropriate
- [ ] No regression in MCP stdio protocol, SQLite persistence, or live SSE projection
